disposition_reason: The paper combines descriptive OFC/state-inference results with native neural-model comparisons. The registered complete-paper design identifies a genuine held-neuron conditional-prediction branch, but its exact native split, score, author producer and numerical baseline are unresolved. The existing 60/20/20 future-time prediction policy is explicitly a prospective extension and cannot be used to claim surpassing the paper on its original task.

source_paper.title: The orbitofrontal cortex updates beliefs for state inference

evidence.locator: Published article indexed abstract and Figure2 text; DOI10.1016/j.neuron.2025.10.024
evidence.supports: Rat temporal-wagering state-inference and OFC-inactivation biological scope; no recovered native prediction score.
Related author manuscript describes latent-dynamics study; fetched versions differ in title/content, so it cannot silently replace final journal protocol.
Behavior, inactivation and multi-region electrophysiology in expert/naive rats; MAT/CSV archive and author code route.

evidence.locator: makeTensor_TCA and sessTensor, static retained original source
evidence.supports: Loads SU/S, excludes violation trials, requires at least five units/four block transitions, z-scores and averages event/block tensor; this is a descriptive tensor producer, not held-neuron prediction.
Registered expert/naive OFC state-inference, behavior and TCA scope; held-out-session decoding was a proposal.

evidence.locator: Native reproduction and methods conformance; Prospective improvement design choices; Qualification gates
evidence.supports: Current complete-paper design distinguishes native conditional reconstruction from proposed60/20/20 prediction; native hLDS producer/folds and numeric qualification missing.
Explicit source holes, cohort mappings and native model-comparison uncertainty; these are audit claims, not independently verified paper scores.

target.description: Preserve original expert/naive OFC state inference, latent dynamics and behavioral evidence. Native held-neuron conditional reconstruction is a possible ordered comparison in the paper, but its final-article scoring contract is not directly recovered; it cannot be replaced by future-time forecasting.

dataset.description: Zenodo16997337 v1 OFC_cognitiveStrategies.zip (author-reported md5a51c7736589b12343d41ac4360b60996), containing behavior/inactivation MAT/CSV and expert/naive multi-area recordings.

cohort.description: Expert/naive and brain-area roles must retain original animal/session/unit mapping; complete-paper audit records separate behavior, muscimol, TCA and latent-session denominators, including a neuronal-count discrepancy. Dataset metadata verifies these roles but not a full native scoring roster.

split.description: Exact original held-time/held-neuron partition and decoder folds remain unavailable. The existing chronological60/20/20 policy is new benchmark design, not the paper split; target neurons may have training observations in native conditional reconstruction.

inputs.description: Author deposit supplies session-level sorted neural observations and task/behavior structures; original tensor code loads SU and S. Saved DecoderOutput, ATI or latent/model products must not be substituted for independently regenerated predictions.

preprocessing.description: TCA source preprocessing is directly inspected, including all-trial z-scoring and event/block averaging; hLDS square-root count transforms, timing, smoothing/filtering and exact source dependencies require separate native binding. TCA semantics cannot substitute for prediction-model semantics.

metric.description: Recover the native held-neuron prediction loss and complete normalization/support. Prospective MSE of square-root50ms counts in the repository is not independently verified as the paper score; MI, ATI, TCA fit and p-values are distinct endpoints.

aggregation.description: Original neuron/session/animal score aggregation and cohort inclusion are not recovered. Prospective bins→neurons→sessions→rats equal weighting must not be represented as the source aggregation.

comparison.primary_metric: Native hLDS held-neuron conditional-prediction metric unresolved; prospective future-time MSE is not an admissible substitute.

published_baseline.description: No numeric final-paper native prediction baseline recovered. Behavioral and inactivation effects, MI and ATI values cannot stand in for prediction performance.

reproduced_author_baseline.description: The retained original tensor loader does not implement the missing hLDS/held-neuron evaluation. No qualified author prediction rerun is available.

minimum_effect.rationale: Source prediction metric, scale and variance must be recovered before a scientifically meaningful gain is fixed.

uncertainty.method: Once original comparison is recovered, predeclare paired inference respecting animal/session dependence and every native evaluation unit; no significance threshold is assumed.
uncertainty.independent_unit: Animal, with repeated sessions/neuron/time bins nested; native role mapping still unresolved.
uncertainty.rationale: Many neurons or bins do not supply independent biological replication; new rat-weighted aggregation cannot silently replace the original score.

paper_win_requires: Recover and authenticate the final-paper native prediction producer, original split, exact inputs/cohorts, metric and numerical baseline.
Keep descriptive belief/TCA/MI/ATI and intervention reproduction separate from prediction performance.
Compare candidate with the qualified author method under identical original information availability, target support and aggregation.
The repository60/20/20 prospective protocol, forecasting, new animal holdouts or different ordinary-LDS dimensionality are separately reported extensions.
Freeze a meaningful gain, uncertainty rule and budgets before evaluation; no paper win while source anchors remain unresolved.

current_sota.description: No current-SOTA comparison is established by the descriptive paper, source design or prospective benchmark policy.

episode.improvement_loop: Source-recovery stage only. Future iteration needs the original prediction-task contract and train/validation access; proposed prospective branches remain extensions until independently admitted.
episode.candidate_freeze: After native recovery, freeze fitted program, model selection, latent convention, information cutoff, cohort and aggregation before original final evaluation.
episode.final_evaluation: Run source-comparable native scoring with a qualified author comparator on complete original support. No prospective60/20/20 score can authorize a same-task paper claim.
episode.baseline_policy: Separate printed source results, source-faithful author rerun and newly authored prospective hLDS/LDS controls. Neither TCA reconstruction nor a local mean baseline is the paper-performance comparator.

blocking_issues: Native prediction target, folds, complete scoring recipe and numeric baseline not recovered.
Final article/preprint version and missing hLDS/held-neuron producers remain unresolved.
Animal/session/role mapping and original aggregation unqualified.
Working same-task evaluator, meaningful effect, valid uncertainty and concrete episode budgets absent.

legacy.notes: Preserve original author tensor source, complete-paper runtime design and prospective prediction machinery. Their reproduction/calibration outputs and new-split extension gains are not paper-win evidence.
